body:
## Problem / why
Multiple bespoke subscriber/alert mechanisms must move onto the shared bus without breaking callers.

## Goal / value
Migrate each consumer to the subscriber/transport API with a compatibility shim so behavior is identical
during migration, then remove shims.

## In scope
- event_bus.on/emit -> registry (shim); orchestration_context.route -> alert-policy consumer;
  ops_phase/pipeline_capabilities/parked_review -> subscriber API; notification_system/alerts -> transports.

## Out of scope
- Deleting the frozen dashboard websocket (E11); new consumers.

## Acceptance criteria
- Each migrated consumer behaves identically; test_event_ssot + related tests green; upstream callers unchanged.

## Verification / test plan
- Per-consumer regression tests; wired_audit green.

## Dependencies & links
- E4, E5, E6.

label: PF Backlog 583
title: Eventing SSOT: migrate existing consumers (event_bus/context/ops/capabilities/parked/notifications/alerts) behind shims

impact_review.claim: Consolidate event_bus.emit on core.events canonical stream
impact_review.recommendation: Delegate to core.events.emit while preserving in-proc callback dispatch.

impact_review.claim: Preserve in-process callback subscription via on() shim
impact_review.recommendation: Maintain _HANDLERS in-process registry with exact callback delivery.

impact_review.claim: API CHECK: Internal consumer migration does not require new external API surface
impact_review.recommendation: Confirm needs_api=false; external SSE stream and subscription CRUD are scoped to BI-PF-1274.

impact_review.claim: AC CHECK: Acceptance criteria cover all consumers, shims, regression tests, and zero drift
impact_review.recommendation: Proceed with full test coverage across all affected modules.

impact_review.claim: LANGUAGE CHECK: Edit-only to existing shipped Python modules with no new Python files in core/
impact_review.evidence: AGENTS.md tool usage + language rule (fast band)
impact_review.recommendation: Modify existing core/ files; place tests in test-framework/tests/.

assumptions: A1: Existing callers of event_bus.on/emit must experience no breaking signature or return type changes.
A2: Notification system and alerts retain exact public interfaces as transport adapters.
divergences: No divergences from ADR-0005/ADR-0011; eliminates diverging events.jsonl writes by consolidating on core.events.
existing_path: core/event_bus.py: writes to products/.orchestration/events.jsonl and dispatches in-process handlers.
core/orchestration_context.py: routes events through _POLICY dict to deterministic coordinator decisions.
core/notification_system.py: manages user notifications store; core/alerts.py: sends email alerts.
prior_decisions: ADR-0001: Go-first for new logic, edits-only to existing shipped Python without creating new .py files in core/.
ADR-0005 & ADR-0011: Eventing & Alerting SSOT; Go event core is the authority; PostgreSQL is the event store.
BI-PF-1272: Cut over core/events.py as thin-client over go_host event_append wire seam.
BI-PF-0233: Project-scoped bus events mirror into the canonical per-project stream.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/alerts.py, core/context_discipline.py, core/context_engine.py

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: core.event_bus.emit() delegates to core.events.emit() canonical Go-backed event seam while preserving in-process callback dispatch and caller signature.
AC-2: core.event_bus.on() provides an in-process subscription shim ensuring existing handlers for all KINDS receive dispatched events with backward-compatible dict envelopes.
AC-3: core.orchestration_context.route() and build() consume events from the canonical stream while preserving _POLICY action mappings and coordinator escalation rules.
AC-4: core.ops_phase.py, core.pipeline_capabilities.py, and scripts/dev/parked_review.py operate without regression over the event bus shim.
AC-5: core.notification_system.py and core.alerts.py maintain identical public API signatures while integrating as transport adapters for notify and email.
AC-6: All existing unit and contract tests in test-framework/tests/ remain green with 0 unwired or naming violations in wired_audit.
